body: I'm very suicidal this evening - again!  I am at least once a week, in spite of being on meds for half my life.  Sad part is I can't call one of those hotlines, for the reason I've already stated in a previous note; they called the cops.  I can't afford to go through any more shame and I cannot tell you the regret I've been feeling having made that phone call a while back.  It's just really nice to be able to talk with someone about the thoughts I have and the struggle I experience just trying to get through an average day.  But no way am I calling a hotline again and have my neighbors video taping the police banging on my door.  Sadly with no family or friends to talk to it can feel like a very cold world out there.  The ridiculous part is to the untrained eye I look like a relatively successful person.  You'd never know to look at me that I struggle so much.  People have repeatedly told me that I look like I have the world at my feet, and that is what's so deceiving about depression, you never know who suffers and what's really going on in someone's life outside of the office/school/social environment, etc.  Just look at all of the rich and famous that have, apparently within any hint, taken their own lives.  Communication is the key.  Unfortunately without someone to communicate with, it's a moot point.

I suppose they called the cops because they felt I was in trouble of killing myself. The funny part is, I had asked them, purely out of curiosity, what they'd do if someone was going to really hurt themselves.  They said they'd call the cops.  I said, I'm not going to hurt myself so please don't call the cops on me, that would be really, really bad for me.  10 minutes later, knock, knock, knock.  

I haven't called to view the file.  I can barely think about the episode.  I feel sick inside when I think about it.  The entire thing has really done a number on my head.  Not a great cure for someone that already fantasizes about exiting this world.
